# GitHub Copilot instructions

All project context, conventions and rules for AI agents live in **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** at the repository root. It is the single source of truth shared with Claude Code and other AI tools.

**Before suggesting or making any change, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow it.** If anything here conflicts with AGENTS.md, AGENTS.md wins.

## Rules for this file

- Don't add project rules here. Put them in `AGENTS.md` so every AI tool sees the same instructions.
- Use this file only for settings that exist solely in Copilot. There are none at the moment.
